_doc: template v1.14 (2026-11-07): plain-language delivery directions that drama3_generate.py puts in front of a chunk that has no [tag] of its own (one per chunk, Drama 3 only, never in QC texts or the script). Drama 3 performs bracketed directions instead of reading them (docs.fish.audio Drama 3: 'Describe the delivery in your own words'; audio.cpp fish_drama3: event tags like [sighs] [laughs]). Kinds: question / exclaim / statement by the chunk's text, lively = 2nd pitch-gate retry. Keep them short, calm and conversational: the audio.cpp port warns that strong emotion prompts can cause prolonged reactions. enabled=false switches the feature off.
